title: Wave, AXE and the browser accessibility audit

videos.script: The booking page from lesson 12 has eight defects. Today a machine looks for them. {{page}} axe is a library of rules. Playwright opens the page, axe runs inside it, and every rule that fails prints a line. {{run}} Four lines. The missing language, the pale grey, the logo with no text, the field with no label. And the script exits with a one, so a pipeline stops. {{four}} Fix those four and run it again. Zero violations. {{zero}} Lighthouse agrees, more or less. Fifty-five before, ninety after. {{score}} Now press Tab. The Book button still cannot be reached. The focus is still invisible. The error is still only red. {{still}} Nothing reported those three. They are not hidden. A rule just cannot know that a div was meant to be a button. {{why}} So this lesson is about two things. Running the tools well, as a gate on every commit. {{gate}} And reading a green result for exactly what it says: these rules passed, on this page, in this state. Nothing more. {{claim}}
